question: Which characters should be removed from the beginning and end of each line?
why_it_matters: The trimming rule determines whether non-ASCII whitespace and meaningful line content survive normalization.
recommendation_reason: Restricting trimming to ASCII space and tab gives precise behavior while preserving other Unicode characters.

options.description: Remove only ASCII spaces and tabs at each line edge.
Remove all Unicode whitespace at each line edge.
Remove ASCII spaces and tabs only from the end of each line.
